Total Burn Ban for Billings County
On July 31, 2026 the Billings County Commission passed Resolution 2026-15 to enact a total burn ban in the County. See the Emergency Alert Bar at the top for more details. Read on...
Billings County Redistricting Board Statement Regarding New Five-District Map
On June 29, 2026, the Billings County Commission voted to convene the Billings County Redistricting Board for purposes of redistricting the County into 5 commissioners' districts following the outcome of the June 2026 election. Read on...
